newsitem.title: USA: Brookdale Living shares offered at $11.50.
newsitem.headline: Brookdale Living shares offered at $11.50.

text.p: Brookdale Living Communities Inc said Friday it completed an initial public offering of 4.5 million shares of its common stock at $11.50 per share, resulting in net proceeds to the company of $48.1 million.
The net proceeds will be used, among other things, to fund pending acquisitions and for working capital, Brookdale said.
All of the shares were offered by the company.

The company had granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 675,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments, if any. Excluding these shares, the company has 6.5 million common shares outstanding.
Brookdale provides senior and assisted living facilities and, including the pending acquisitions, will operate facilities containing 2,168 units in urban and suburban areas across the country.

Brookdale is the successor to the senior and assisted living division of The Prime Group Inc. Prime and Brookdale senior management own 4.5 million shares of common stock, including 2.5 million shares that were purchased at the initial public offering.
Underwriters for the offering were led by Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc.
